limitations: This cohort is not a complete historical PLACSP archive and contract values are not verified payments.

All 128849 official-source counterparty names and identifiers are retained exactly, including 8260 natural-person and 3058 unclassified counterparties; classification never suppresses public-domain evidence.
The artifact is local and has not passed a clean-room restore from a durable public origin.
corpora.next_gate: Ingest the complete official archive by bounded time cohorts, reconcile source totals and revisions, publish one million real facts, and prove clean-room restore.

corpora.label: BDNS subsidy concessions
limitations: This is a bounded 1419-page cohort containing 1360382 of 28676987 official concessions observed on 2026-08-12 across 89 complete date windows; it is not the complete historical registry.

All 1360382 official beneficiary names and all 163270 source-published identifiers are retained exactly; the remaining 1197112 counterparties are explicitly unclassified and no identity field is suppressed.
Published subsidy amounts are award values, not independently verified disbursements or outcomes.
The artifact is local and has not passed a clean-room restore from a durable public origin.
corpora.next_gate: Capture a second snapshot for real revision deltas, extend through bounded historical cohorts, publish immutable artifacts, reconcile published source totals, and prove clean-room restore.

corpora.label: Cross-source accountability ledger
limitations: The clean 2026-08-12 materialization contains 126760 rows from boe_api_legal, congreso_votaciones, and senado_votaciones; ten fixture-derived PLACSP/BDNS rows and their downstream issues and ledger entries were removed.
The corpus is dominated by parliamentary actions and is not representative of money, implementation, enforcement, audits, or outcomes.
Twenty-six legacy rows infer boe_api_legal from an allowlisted official BOE URL because their stored source_id is blank; that inference is explicit in source_id_scope.
The artifact is local and has not passed a clean-room restore from a durable public origin.
corpora.next_gate: Expand the ledger with representative rules, appointments, money, implementation, enforcement, audit, and outcome facts; reach one million real rows and prove public-origin restore.
